name: PRONOUS
description: BSC spot-only tokenized-stock market desk for bStocks, Ondo and xStocks. Reads Binance Web3 RWA prices, flags unreliable gaps, and keeps execution behind quote, simulation and confirmation.
note: ERC-8004 identity is minted and independently verified on BSC Mainnet. The trading execution path remains separately gated by wallet, simulation and explicit confirmation. x402 runtime remains disabled.
